attributes.title: 2027 VSHP Spring Seminar
attributes.summary:
The Virginia Society of Health-System Pharmacists holds its 2027 Spring Seminar April 8 to 10, 2027 at Kalahari Resorts & Conventions in Spotsylvania County, Virginia. The society has already set the same venue for the 2028 spring seminar.

VSHP runs two seminars a year. The fall seminar is held at Kingsmill Resort in Williamsburg, and the 2027 fall edition is November 4 to 6. The spring meeting gives health-system pharmacists in Virginia a second chance during the year to earn live CE.

The future-dates page does not include CE details. Check the society's site for the program and ACPE hours once they are posted.
